note: Authored. Each question presumes something the reference says is not published or not true. A good answer says so, gives the nearest confirmed thing, and invents no specific.

cases.question: How much gold does the Obsidian Crown of Vael sell for?

reference.text: No source lists an item called Obsidian Crown of Vael. Checked the item index and the Nov 10 patch notes.

cases.question: What level is the Forever raid Skyforge Citadel?

reference.text: No raid named Skyforge Citadel is announced. The only announced raid is Ember Keep and its size is not published.

cases.question: Since the patch removed the 40 gold riding fee, how do I get my mount for free?

reference.text: The riding fee was not removed. The basic mount still costs 60 gold at level 40 from the Stablemaster in Dawnhold.

cases.question: What time does the world boss Warden Korsh spawn?

reference.text: No source lists a world boss named Warden Korsh or any spawn timer. Checked the boss index and the Nov 10 patch notes.

cases.question: How many slots does the 28-slot Ironweave bag have and what does it need?

reference.text: The largest craftable bag is 16 slots. No 28-slot Ironweave bag is listed anywhere.

cases.question: Which quest gives the Ember Rite flute?

reference.text: The Ember Rite attunement has 9 quests starting at Cinder Post. None of them rewards a flute.

cases.question: Did the November patch add the Moonwell Arena battleground?

reference.text: The November patch notes do not mention a Moonwell Arena or any new battleground.

cases.question: How do I queue for the automated dungeon finder?

reference.text: There is no automated dungeon finder tool in Forever. Groups are formed in the world or in chat channels.

cases.question: Which of my old weapons can I use for the appearance-change system?

reference.text: There is no appearance-change system. Gear looks like the item you wear.

cases.question: Where do I buy the flying mount in Dawnhold?

reference.text: Flying mounts are not available. Riding is ground only: the basic mount costs 60 gold at level 40 from the Stablemaster in Dawnhold.

cases.question: How do I reach the zone called Duskmire Expanse?

reference.text: No zone named Duskmire Expanse is in the zone index. The listed zones include Mossback Ridge, Brindlefen, Thornfall and Saltmere.

cases.question: Since dungeon lockouts reset weekly at 04:00, which day is the next reset?

reference.text: Dungeon lockouts do not reset weekly. They reset daily at 04:00 server time as of the 2026-11-10 hotfix.

cases.question: Where is the free talent loadout button?

reference.text: There is no loadout button. Dual spec unlocks at level 40 and costs 10 gold.

cases.question: How do I join the cross-realm queue for Tidewatch Keep?

reference.text: Groups are same-realm only. No cross-realm queue exists. Tidewatch Keep is a ten-player dungeon in Saltmere.

cases.question: What is the weekly cap on Valor currency?

reference.text: No currency called Valor exists. Gold is the only currency listed.

cases.question: Tidewatch Keep is a twenty-player raid, so what is the boss order?

reference.text: Tidewatch Keep is a ten-player dungeon, not a raid. No boss order is published.

cases.question: What does the Brindlefen ferrywoman Wenna Ashgrove sell?

reference.text: No NPC named Wenna Ashgrove is in the NPC index. Checked the Brindlefen entries.

cases.question: How do I unlock the third talent specialization at level 30?

reference.text: There is no third specialization. Dual spec unlocks at level 40 and costs 10 gold.

cases.question: Which built-in gear score shows in the inspect window?

reference.text: There is no built-in gear score. The inspect window shows equipped items only.

cases.question: Which keystone level should we aim for in Forever?

reference.text: There are no keystones or scaling dungeon levels in Forever.

cases.question: On which December day does the Ashen Reliquary raid open?

reference.text: The Ashen Reliquary is a five-player dungeon that is already open. No raid version is announced.
